meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Find deepening opportunities in a codebase, informed by the domain language in CONTEXT.md and the decisions in docs/adr/. Use when the user wants to improve architecture, find refactoring opportunities, consolidate tightly-coupled modules, or make a codebase more testable and AI-navigable.

copy.tagline: 发现代码库架构改进机会，让代码更可测试、易导航
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在维护一个大型代码库，想找出架构改进点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a large codebase and want to identify architecture improvements

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的代码库，找出架构问题，并提出重构建议，让代码更易测试、更易被 AI 理解。
howto.when: 当你要求改进架构、寻找重构机会、合并紧耦合模块，或让代码库更易测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出这个项目中哪些模块太浅、需要加深。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并列出候选重构项。

say.text: 分析一下订单模块的架构问题。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your codebase to surface architectural friction and propose refactoring opportunities that make the code more testable and AI-navigable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to improve architecture, find refactoring opportunities, consolidate tightly-coupled modules, or make the codebase more testable.

say_en.text: Find shallow modules in this project that need deepening.
Analyze the architecture of the order module.
say_en.note: Claude uses domain language from CONTEXT.md.
